Ib. חַלֵּי מרירתן וכ' sweeten thou the bitterness (sin) of Israel &c.—Ib. מי שיְחַלֶּה וכ' one to sweeten the bitterness &c. (by prayer). Yalk. Ber. 32 a אביי אמר עד שהֶחֱלֵהוּ להקב"ה בתפלה Ms. M. (v. D. S. a. l.) until he assuaged &c., v. supra. [Ib. שה' עליהם וכ', read: שהֵחֵל, v. חָלַל.]

Ib. עמד משה … עד שהחלהו (Ms. M. עד שחלה) Moses stood in prayer … until He wore Him out (by his persistency, v. Rashi a. l. a. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3).—3) (v. חָלַל a. חִלְחֵל) to permeate, affect. Erub. 100 b; a. e., v. גֶּזַע. Pesik. R. s. 11 מַחֲלִיף וכ', v. גָּזַז.

Lev. R. s. 23, end נתח' המלך the king has been succeeded (displaced; Num. R. s. 9, beg. מת וכ'). Yalk. Deut. 813 כיון שנ' וכ' when the governor was recalled and another &c. Num. R. s. 5, beg. להִתְחַלֵּף מעבודה וכ' to be transferred from one service to another. Y. Taan. II, beg. 65 a היו מִתְחַלְּפִין עליה took turns in guarding it.

IX, 10 (158 b) על החֲלוּקִין ואתה בא לחַלֵּק עלינו וכ' … we grieve over the divided opinions, and you come to assert a division for us on things on which they (the schools of Shammai and Hillel) agree?; (Y.
